title: First-Line Supervisors of Police and Detectives
description: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of members of police force.

projection.title: First-line supervisors of police and detectives

tasks.text: Supervise and coordinate the investigation of criminal cases, offering guidance and expertise to investigators, and ensuring that procedures are conducted in accordance with laws and regulations.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Criminal investigation direction needs accountable judgment

tasks.text: Prepare work schedules and assign duties to subordinates.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Routine schedule generation from stated constraints

dwas.name: Prepare activity or work schedules.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Direct collection, preparation, and handling of evidence and personal property of prisoners.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Forensic evidence handling requires chain-of-custody hands

dwas.name: Process forensic or legal evidence in accordance with procedures.

tasks.text: Investigate and resolve personnel problems within organization and charges of misconduct against staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live conflict resolution needs presence and trust

dwas.name: Resolve interpersonal conflicts.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Explain police operations to subordinates to assist them in performing their job duties.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live instruction and hands-on coaching require human presence

dwas.name: Train employees in proper work procedures.

tasks.text: Maintain logs, prepare reports, and direct the preparation, handling, and maintenance of departmental records.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain operational records in structured systems

tasks.text: Inform personnel of changes in regulations and policies, implications of new or amended laws, and new techniques of police work.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI retrieves and explains regulations; human confirms

dwas.name: Inform others about laws or regulations.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Train staff in proper police work procedures.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Live instruction and hands-on coaching require human presence

dwas.name: Train employees in proper work procedures.

tasks.text: Discipline staff for violation of department rules and regulations.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Law enforcement direction is live authority-bearing command

tasks.text: Monitor and evaluate the job performance of subordinates, and authorize promotions and transfers.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Performance review aided; accountability and context human

dwas.name: Evaluate employee performance.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Review contents of written orders to ensure adherence to legal requirements.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Policy compliance document review, human owns final call

dwas.name: Review documents or materials for compliance with policies or regulations.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Conduct raids and order detention of witnesses and suspects for questioning.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically detaining suspects

tasks.text: Cooperate with court personnel and officials from other law enforcement agencies and testify in court, as necessary.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Law enforcement info sharing needs trusted humans

dwas.name: Testify at legal or legislative proceedings.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

dwas.name: Collaborate with law enforcement or security agencies to share information.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Meet with civic, educational, and community groups to develop community programs and events, and to discuss law enforcement subjects.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Program development with outside groups needs humans

dwas.name: Collaborate with outside groups to develop programs or projects.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Inspect facilities, supplies, vehicles, and equipment to ensure conformance to standards.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Security/safety walkthrough requires physical presence

dwas.name: Inspect facilities to ensure compliance with security or safety regulations.
Inspect equipment to ensure safety or proper functioning.

tasks.text: Direct release or transfer of prisoners.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Law enforcement direction is live authority-bearing command

tasks.text: Requisition and issue equipment and supplies.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Develop, implement, and revise departmental policies and procedures.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI proposes procedures; human validates fit

tasks.text: Prepare news releases and respond to police correspondence.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Incident reports drafted from facts; human reviews

tasks.text: Prepare budgets and manage expenditures of department funds.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Law enforcement direction is live authority-bearing command

emerging_tasks.task: Read and review subordinates' reports to ensure legal standards are met and there are no mistakes.
